items.q: There was a family named Paterson in Springfield that were in the undertaki ng business and sometimes Lloyd would engage one or two of their cars to take us on some jobs around Ohio.

ctx.x: I came back to Springfield the same afternoon and I was as happy as a mouse in a cheese factory because I had such a new beautiful and easy blowing instrument. A few days later, we played a dance in Dayton, Ohio, and I had the feeling that I had never played as well as I did that night. I had a case for this horn and I never put it on the fender or running board of any car.

There was a family named Paterson in Springfield that were in the undertaki ng business and sometimes Lloyd would engage one or two of their cars to take us on some jobs around Ohio. They had some beautiful black limousines, but most of the time, if the jobs were not too far away from Springfield, they had a big old high limousine that 10 of us, instruments and the driver, who was the one of the Patersons, could get into without being crowded. Every time we went somewhere in this car, which had been transformed…
with tyres included were 3 feet high which made the car at least high from the ground level to the top.
